entry.title: Goldman Sachs on data in the age of AI
entry.summary: Neema Raphael, Chief Data Officer & Head of Data Engineering, Goldman Sachs discusses the importance of data in the age of AI with Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo at the Building an AI Future-Ready Business event. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: SpaceX Is Planning to Buy Startup Cursor 30 Days After IPO
entry.summary: SpaceX expects to proceed with its acquisition of artificial intelligence coding startup Cursor 30 days after Elon Musk’s company begins trading publicly, according to people familiar with the matter.

entry.title: JPMorgan’s CIO Sees Leadership Test as AI Fuels Major Shift
entry.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. faces a daunting management challenge from artificial intelligence as the bank reaps productivity benefits while racing to contain a new set of risks, Global Chief Information Officer Lori Beer said.

entry.title: Former OpenAI Staffers Warn That xAI’s Poor Safety Record Could Complicate SpaceX’s IPO
entry.summary: The ex-employees, who cofounded a new AI watchdog group, say investors deserve more information about xAI’s safety practices before SpaceX goes public.

entry.title: China’s YMTC Kicks Off IPO Process to Tap Booming Memory Demand
entry.summary: Yangtze Memory Technologies Co. has begun the process for a long-awaited initial public offering, tapping red-hot demand for the chipmakers at the heart of a global AI development boom.

entry.title: Tom Steyer Wants to Save California From Billionaires. But Also Doesn’t Want Them to Leave
entry.summary: The hedge fund billionaire turned gubernatorial candidate wants to tax California’s ultrawealthy, regulate AI, and keep Silicon Valley happy at the same time. Good luck with that.

entry.title: Moonshot AI to Overhaul Structure to Win Nod for Hong Kong IPO
entry.summary: Moonshot AI has informed its investors it will revamp its corporate structure to pave the way for an initial public offering in Hong Kong, aligning with Beijing’s tightened requirements for Chinese companies seeking an overseas debut.

entry.title: Jury Ruling in Musk Lawsuit Favors OpenAI
entry.summary: The ruling appeared to clear a path for OpenAI to file for a much anticipated IPO this year and dent the SpaceX and X owner’s reputation.

entry.title: Seagate Slips as CEO Says New Factories ‘Take Too Long’
entry.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings shares fell 6.9% Monday in its worst one-day drop in nearly two months after management comments at a JPMorgan conference sparked investor fears that the company won’t be able to keep up with soaring demand for memory chips.

entry.title: Elon Musk Says He Wants to Get SpaceX IPO Underway ‘Pretty Soon’
entry.summary: Elon Musk said he’s back in Texas working on plans for an initial public offering of SpaceX as the rocket and artificial intelligence company gears up for the largest listing of all time.

entry.title: Venture Capital Is Concentrating Faster Than Ever. What Happens To Everyone Else?
entry.summary: Capital concentration shows no signs of abating this year. Just through April, U.S. venture capital totals in 2026 are on par with funding for all of 2025, and 80% of startup investment this year so far has gone to rounds of $500 million and more.

Modern AI can orchestrate attacks and suggest exploits, including Mistral's own models. Mensch rules out a sale and says Mistral is aiming for an IPO instead.
